cases.title: Lists: the pencil opens "Edit list"; renaming and describing a list is saved
Contacts filtered by a list: "Rename list" on the List chip renames it and updates the chip
Prospect lists: "Rename" on an uploaded list saves the new name
Team: "Resend invite" on a pending invite issues a new invitation (old one revoked) and shows the result banner
Team: "Hierarchy" sets Sales level 3 reporting to an L2 manager; Reports to never offers the person themselves
Team: a manager cannot be put under someone in their own team (descendants are not offered)
Team: inviting with Sales level 4 and Reports to stores the hierarchy for the new account
Team: "Team tree" opens the read-only hierarchy (Sales team)
Domain health: "Add domain" validates the name, then shows the SPF / DKIM / DMARC records to publish
DNS panel: "Check status" runs the diagnostics and refreshes SPF / DMARC from UNKNOWN
Domain card: Details -> "DNS records" reopens the records for that domain
